items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: Alonzo Hardy was the first bandmaster I had been in the college. John Brown succeeded him. I succeeded John Brown.

ctx.x: South Carolina, and that's the band I came up in. How young were the youngest ones in there usually?

Four years of age. Four years of age. Little Sammy Coates directed the band as a comedy director, however. Yes. Under me, under Hardy, under John Brown, and under Brooks Brockman. Brooks Brockman lived in Los Angeles until about three years ago, and he died. Now, I'm leaving the Jenkins orphanage now. I'm also leaving Benedict College. I didn't stay there, but a term and a half. The president told me the college could very well do without me next year for obvious reasons, some of which I hold as a secret that I…
It's just the truth. How do college students drink now? Well, yes. Same as I don't know.
